launch_cutline.description: Stable is the minimum claim-scope label considered launch-qualified; Beta, Preview, and Withdrawn fall below the cutline.

stop_rules.title: Inherited row downgrade
stop_rules.rationale: The qualification row or claim publication narrowed below the cutline; the export inherits it and is gated upstream.

stop_rules.title: Qualification evidence stale
stop_rules.rationale: A qualification dimension's evidence went stale; the export must narrow until it refreshes.

stop_rules.title: Retest pending
stop_rules.rationale: A dimension or boundary requires a retest; the export must narrow until it completes.

stop_rules.title: Skew window exceeded
stop_rules.rationale: A peer is outside the supported skew window; the export must narrow.

stop_rules.title: Deprecation scheduled
stop_rules.rationale: The family is deprecated with a scheduled removal; the export must narrow.

stop_rules.title: Support window ended
stop_rules.rationale: The support window has ended; the export must withhold the row.

stop_rules.title: Validity window expired
stop_rules.rationale: The claim-scope validity window expired; the export must renew it before publishing.

stop_rules.title: Export evidence stale
stop_rules.rationale: The export proof packet or a backing report breached its freshness SLO; a still-stable claim holds promotion.

stop_rules.title: Export evidence missing
stop_rules.rationale: No export proof packet or backing report was captured; a still-stable claim holds promotion.

stop_rules.title: Owner sign-off missing
stop_rules.rationale: Required owner sign-off is missing; a still-stable claim holds promotion.

stop_rules.title: Waiver expired
stop_rules.rationale: A waiver the row relied on expired; a still-stable claim holds promotion.

stop_rules.title: Claim publication missing
stop_rules.rationale: The backing public claim publication is missing; the export holds promotion.
